<entry id="P00992">
<head-word>עִנְיָן</head-word>
<head-word>עִנְיָין</head-word>
<head-word>עִי'</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="P00952"> עָנָה I)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>answer, corresponding affair</italic>,] 
<italic>correspondence, relation; subject, object, affair, idea</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifra introd. שהוא כעִנְיָנוֹ in keeping with the general subject to which it is related, v. טָעַן I; שלא כענינו out of relation to the general subject. Kidd. 6
<sup>a</sup> והוא שעסוקין באותו ע' provided they are engaged in conversation on that subject (of marriage). Ib. מע' לע' באותו ע' when their conversation changed from one point to another all, however, having relation to that subject (of marriage, e.g. about dowry, about the man’s financial condition). B. Bath. 114
<sup>a</sup> כל זמן שעוסקין באותו ע' so long as the judges are engaged in that case (of donation), opp. כל זמן שיושבין so long as they are in session. Kidd. 43
<sup>a</sup> אם אינו ע' לגופו תנהו ע' לכל וכ' if it (that word ההוא in the text) has no bearing on the subject itself (because a previous ההוא has already intimated the exclusion of a messenger), make it bear on all laws of the Torah (that you cannot authorize a deputy for an unlawful act). Tosef. Meg. IV (III), 5 [read:] בבית הוועד שואלין לעִנְיַין הפסח וכ' in the school house the subject of Passover laws is discussed thirty days (before the festival). Tosef. Sot. VI, 2, v. עָנָה I. Cant. R. to I, 10 (ref. to Num. XXVII, 1-11, a. 12-23) וכי מה ע' זה לזה what relation is there between these two subjects?; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. עִנְיָנוֹת, עִנְיָי', עִי'</plural-form>. Tosef. Meg. l. c. מדלגין מע' הפסח הכתובין בתורה Var. ed. Zuck. (ed. בעניין, corr. acc.) they skip (make selections) from the Scriptural passages relating to Passover. Tosef. Sabb. XIII (XIV), 4 ברכות אע"פ וע' הרבה שבתורה וכ' … benedictions (prayers), even if there be in them some of the letters of the Divine Name and many selections from the Torah, should not be saved from fire (on the Sabbath); Y. ib. XVI, 15
<sup>c</sup>; Treat. Sof’rim XV, 4. Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 55
<sup>a</sup> bot. מה פליגין כשהפליגו דעתן לע' אחרים in what case do they differ? When they had turned their mind to other points, opp. to עסוקין באותו עניין (v. supra); Y. Gitt. VI, 47
<sup>d</sup> bot. (corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>pl.</italic>) the extension of their purpose.—Ned. 51
<sup>a</sup> אמר ליה כי ע' קדמאה he said to him something similar to the first proposition (‘let thy wife offer me a measure of wine’); עיביד כי ע' קדמאה do according to the first proposition. B. Bath. 9
<sup>a</sup> עבדי ע' בהדי הדדי וכ' made an arrangement between themselves that &c. Ib. 114
<sup>a</sup> sq. דיסליקו מע' לע' they turned from one affair to another; a. fr.—
<italic>Pl.</italic> עִנְיָנִין, עִנְיָי', עִי'. Targ. Cant. I, 11 סכום ע' וכ' the sum of their various interpretations is forty-nine. Targ. Ps. XLI, 2 לעִנְיָינֵי מסכנא Ms. (ed. לעניי, corr. acc.) to the affairs (needs) of the poor (cmp. Lev. R. s. 34, quot. s. v. זָכָה).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="P01000">
<head-word>עָנָן</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>cloud</italic>, frequently used in the sense of 
<italic>cover protection</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 60 כל זמן … היה ע' קשור וכ' as long as Sarah lived, a cloud was tied over the entrance of her tent; וכיון שמתה פסק אותו ע' and when she was dead, that cloud ceased. Cant. R. to II, 6 וימינו זה עֲנַן שכינה וכ' … ‘and his right hand embraces me’, that means the cloud of the Divine Presence in the future world (with ref. to Is. LX, 19). Y. Taan. III, 66
<sup>c</sup>, v. עָנָיו; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. עֲנָנִים</plural-form>. Taan. 9
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Gen. II, 6) מלמד שהע' מתגברים וכ' this teaches that the clouds (like a hose) swell and rise to the sky, and there open their mouth like a hose and receive the rain water; Gen. R. s. 13. Ib. אין ע' אלא מלמעלה clouds (like a hose to receive the waters) come from above (ref. to Dan. VII, 13); אין ע' אלא מלמטה the clouds come from below (ref. to Ps. CXXXV, 7); Y. Succ. I, 52
<sup>b</sup> bot.; Yalk. Ps. 883. R. Hash. 3
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Num. XXI, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition />
<notes> שמע … ונסתלקו עַנְנֵי כבוד he heard that Aaron was dead, and the clouds of glory were removed. Tanḥ. R’eh 16 משיב רוחות ומעלה ע' ומוריד וכ' causes the winds to blow, and the clouds to rise, and the rains to come down; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="P01001">
<head-word>עֲנַן</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<head-word>עֲנָנָא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same.</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Targ. Is. XLIV, 22. Targ. Job VII, 9 Ms. (ed. תננא). Targ. O. Lev. XXIII, 43 עֲנָנִי ed. Berl. (oth. ed. עננין); a. fr.—Ber. 59
<sup>a</sup> דקטר בע' when the sky is covered with a light cloud, opp. עֵיבָא. Ib. דבריק בע', v. בְּרַק I. Gen. R. s. 13 כך הקב"ה … אייתי עֲנָנִיךְ וקבל וכ' so the Lord says to the earth, bring thy cloud (hose, v. preced.) and receive the rain; Yalk. Ps. 883; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. עֲנָנִין, עֲנָנַיָּא, עֲנָנֵי</plural-form>. Targ. II Sam. XXII, 12. 
<pgbrk id="pg1096" />Targ. Is. XLV, 8. Targ. Y. II Num. XXI, 1 ע' דיקרא (= ענני כבוד, v. preced.); a. fr.—Ber. l. c. (expl. רעמים, ib. IX, 2) ע' בגלגלא clouds (rolling) in the sphere; (oth. opin.) ע' דשפכי מיא וכ' clouds (bottles, v. preced.) that empty the waters from one to the other; ib. ע' חלחולי וכ', v. חַלְחֵל; בריק ברקא ומנהמי ע' וכ' the lightning flashes and the clouds rumble, and then comes the rain. Taan. 25
<sup>a</sup> שמעינהו לע' דאמרי נשדי מיטרא וכ' Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) overheard the clouds say, let us cast rain on Ammon &c. Cant. R. to IV, 8 כד אינון נקיין מן ע' (some ed. עֲנָנָן, f.) when the heavens are cloudless; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<binyan>

<binyan-form>הֶעֱנִיק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>

<notes> Yoma 10
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Num. l. c.) שמַעֲנִיקִין החמה בקומתן they lorded it over the sun by virtue of their height; Sot. 34
<sup>b</sup> (Rashi: they had the appearance of 
<italic>squeezing</italic> their heads 
<italic>into</italic> the sun).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>to suspend around the neck, load</italic>,] 
<italic>to outfit the emancipated slave with gifts</italic> (Deut. XV, 14).</definition>
<notes> Y. Kidd. I, 59
<sup>c</sup> bot. אילו שמַעֲנִיקִין להן וכ' the following are those who must be sent away with gifts; Bab. ib. 16
<sup>b</sup>. Ib. יכול לא יהיו מַעֲנִיקִים וכ' you might think that only he who is discharged after the expiration of six years of servitude, must be outfitted. Sifré Deut. 119 שאם הֶעֱנַקְתָּ … תַּעֲנִיק לו וכ' that when thou hast outfitted him once, thou must do it again &c. Kidd. l. c. כמה מעניקים לו how much must he be given?; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

I, 9) אם … כע' זה שרף על וכ' if a man trains himself to be like a necklace which is loose around the neck, and is (sometimes) seen and (sometimes) not seen (i.e. is yielding and modest), his learning will be established &c.; Yalk. <plural-form>Pl. עֲנָקִים</plural-form>. Gen. R. s. 26 (they are called ʿĂnaḳim) שהיו מרבים ע' ע"ג עֳנָקִים they increased the chains around the necks (subjugated many people); Yalk. ib. 47.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>a</sup> (ref. to II Sam. XII, 9) מה חרב … אין אתה נ' עליו וכ' as well as thou art not to be punished for the use of the sword against the sons of Ammon, so shalt thou not be

<sup>b</sup>; B. Kam. 93
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. המוסר … הוא נ' תחלה he who appeals to the Lord for judgment against his neighbor, will himself be the first to be punished. Snh. 8

<definition>

<notes> Sot. I, 9 מי לנו גדול מיוסף שלא נ' בו אלא משה who is greater than Joseph, to whose body none attended but Moses himself? (v. supra); מי גדול ממשה שלא ני בו וכ' who is greater than Moses in whose burial none but the Lord himself was engaged? Lev. R. s. 25 מתחלת ברייתו … לא נ' וכ' soon after the creation the Lord was first of all engaged in planting (Gen. II, 8), אף אתם לא תִתְעַסְּקוּ וכ' even so, when you enter the land, you shall apply yourselves first of all to planting (Lev. XIX, 23). Y. Ḥag. II, 77
<sup>b</sup> וישבו ונִתְעַסְּקוּ, v. next w. Tanḥ. Vaëra 5 (play on הָעשֶׁק, Koh. VII, 7) עסק שנ' שלמה … הטעהו (not הטעוהו) the occupation with vain things in which Solomon engaged, led him astray; ib. כשהחכם מִתְעַסֵּק בדברים הרבה מערבבין וכ' when a scholar engages in too many affairs, they confound him so that he loses his wisdom; ib. חכם המתעסק בצרכי צבור משכחין וכ' if a scholar busies himself with public affairs, they cause him to forget his learning; a. fr.—Tosef. Arakh. IV, 27 מִתְעַסֵּק בירק בקדרה בכל יום may arrange to have vegetables in the pot every day; מתעסק ירק בקדרה ואלפס וכ' (read: בירק) may have vegetables in the pot and stew &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to do a thing without a direct practical purpose; to practice, experiment</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 157
<sup>b</sup> מתעסק בעלמא אנא I was merely playing (without the intention of measuring). R. Hash. IV, 8 (32
<sup>b</sup>) אבל מִתְעַסְּקִין בהם כדי שילמדו Ms. M. (ed. מתע' עמהם עד) but you may practice with them that they may learn (to blow the Shofar); והמתעסק לא יצא and he who merely blows for practice, has not done his duty. Ib. 33
<sup>a</sup> מתע' בהן עד שילמדו וכ' (Tosef. ib. IV (II), 10 מתלמדין לתקוע) you may practice with them …, even on the Sabbath; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to do one thing while intending to do another thing; to miss one’s purpose, choose the wrong thing</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 62
<sup>b</sup> המתעסק בחלבים וכ' he that misses his purpose in selecting forbidden fat to eat (intending to reach out for a permitted piece), or in consanguineous connection (by mistaking the person) is bound to bring a sin offering; המתע' בשבת who does a forbidden act by mistake on the Sabbath (meaning to do a different though forbidden act); Kerith. 19
<sup>b</sup>. Ib. IV, 3 (19
<sup>a</sup>) (ref. to אשר חטא בה, Lev. IV, 23) פרט למתעסק this is to exempt him who sinned by doing the thing which he had not intended to do. Ib. 19
<sup>b</sup> מתעסק דמאי to what kind of a mistaken act does this refer? Ib. מתע' בדבר דלאו מצוה if by mistake he did an act which was not commanded (for that day). Ib. מתע' בחבורה making a wound (on the Sabbath) by mistake (circumcising the wrong child), opp. מקלקל בחבורה doing harm by making a wound; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to dispute, argue</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 8 עד שמלאכי השרת מדיינין … ומתעסקין אלו עם אלו וכ' while the ministering angels were arguing with one another, disputing with one another, God created him (Adam); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<italic>affair, display</italic>. Men. X, 3 (65
<sup>a</sup>) כדי שיהא נקצר בע' גדול that the cutting of the ‘Omer may take place with great display (in the presence of many people); Koh. R. to I, 3.—

<sense>

<italic>pl.</italic>); a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>‘is</italic>
<italic>ḳ</italic>
<italic>a</italic>,

<italic>‘is</italic>
<italic>ḳ</italic>

<italic>‘is</italic>
<italic>ḳ</italic>
<italic>a</italic> (business), because he has a right to say to him, I have given it to thee to trade with, v. עֲסֵק. Ib. חד ע' ותרי שטרי (not חדא) if one 
<italic>‘is</italic>
<italic>ḳ</italic>

<sup>a</sup> האי מאן דקביל ע' מחבריה וכ' if one took merchandise on shares from his neighbor and suffered loss, but afterwards took pains and recovered the loss. Ib. הני בי תרי ע' בהדי הדדי … if two entered a partnership with each other (one furnishing the capital). Bets. 32
<sup>b</sup> בעא מנייהו ע' he asked them to give him goods on shares; a. e.—
<italic>Pl.</italic> עִסְקִין, עִסְקֵי, עִי'. Targ. II Kings IV, 13. Targ. Y. Gen. II, 2 עשרתי ע' ten things.—B. Mets. l. c. תרי ע' וחד שטרא (Rashi

<italic>‘is</italic>
<italic>ḳ</italic>
<italic>as</italic> and one document made out on both together. Ker. l. c., v. supra; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

Fr.) addit. s. 4; Pesik. Bayom, p. 193
<sup>b</sup> הק"בה עוֹצֵר וכ' the Lord locks his Presence up with them, v. infra. Ab. Zar. 71
<sup>a</sup> עול תחתי לעוֹצֵר, v. עָלַל; a. fr.—Part. pass. עָצוּר; f. עֲצוּרָה; 
<plural-form>pl. עֲצוּרִים, עְצוּרִין; עְצוּרוֹת</plural-form>. Sifré l. c. מה זה ע' מלצאת אף זה ע' וכ' as on this (the eighth day) one is prohibited to leave, so is one on this (the first day). Sifré Deut. 135 (ref. to עצרת, Deut. XVI, 8) יכול יהא אדם ע' כל וכ' from this you might infer that one must be confined the whole day in the schoolhouse (for religious exercises).
